scripts.dev: npm run build -w @wurcluego/shared && concurrently -n API,WEB -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @wurcluego/server" "npm run dev -w @wurcluego/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @wurcluego/shared && npm run build -w @wurcluego/server && npm run build -w @wurcluego/client
scripts.test: npm run test -w @wurcluego/server && npm run test -w @wurcluego/client
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @wurcluego/server && npm run lint -w @wurcluego/client
